question: Solve: [(144/12) + (43 × 3)] + 45 - 20 × 3
solution:
**Given:**

The expression [(144/12) + (43 × 3)] + 45 - 20 × 3 

**Concept:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e7a20e61846c6ccd67207a3bc8b140be1db7470dc5524d0e4aa6bcd15a3ce09.png] 

**Calculation:**

According to the question

⇒ [(144/12) + (43 × 3)] + 45 - 20 × 3

⇒ [12 + 129] + 45 - 60

⇒ 141 + 45 - 60

⇒ 186 - 60

⇒ 126

**∴ The required result will be 126**
